headlines.title: 25 years ago, Tom Brokaw anchors 9/11 NBC News Special Report
headlines.description: 25 years ago, Tom Brokaw delivered an NBC News Special Report on September 11, 2001, after terrorists hijacked four commercial planes and carried out coordinated attacks against targets in the U.S. Two were flown into the World Trade Center's Twin Towers, one into the Pentagon, and one – after the passengers and crew fought back – crashed into a field in Shanksville, Pennsylvania, killing nearly 3,000 people.

headlines.title: More AI researchers warn of AI's threat to humanity
headlines.description: NBC News' Tom Llamas spoke to two more artificial intelligence researchers about the potential threat A.I has to humanity. This comes after AI researcher Jacob Coxon shared a viral tweet saying he believed AI could kill humanity in the next decade. Llamas also spoke to Incoming Professor at UC Berkley Sayash Kapoor who also warns of risk, but says policy proposals and regulations can help prevent further threats.

headlines.title: Iran-backed Houthis seize Red Sea coastline, tightening grip on vital shipping lane
headlines.description: The Houthi rebels effectively completed their rapid push to take control of Yemen’s Red Sea coastline on Friday, tightening their grip on one of the world’s most important shipping routes and delivering a dramatic boost to their backers in Iran.

headlines.title: They led vigils to victims of Tiananmen. Now they’re facing time in prison for it.
headlines.description: Three pro-democracy activists in Hong Kong who organized annual vigils for victims of China’s 1989 Tiananmen Square crackdown were sentenced Friday under a national security law that critics say has stifled dissent.

headlines.title: Singer D4vd sued by parents of teen girl he is accused of killing
headlines.description: Celeste Rivas Hernandez’s parents are suing the singer D4vd, accusing him of wrongful death after he was charged in the 14-year-old girl’s murder.

headlines.title: 49ers easily defeat ‘withered’ Rams in battle of competing Australian jet lag strategies
headlines.description: The San Francisco 49ers easily dispatched the “withered” — and perhaps jet lagged — Los Angeles Rams, 27-7, scoring a decisive victory for hyper-punctual business travelers across the globe.

headlines.title: Indiana Supreme Court rules for state senator over Trump-backed candidate in GOP primary recount
headlines.description: Indiana’s Supreme Court ruled after a months-long recount that a Republican incumbent state senator narrowly defeated his Trump-backed challenger in the GOP primary for the state Senate seat.

headlines.title: Emma Bonino, leader of abortion and divorce battles that changed Italy, dies at 78
headlines.description: Emma Bonino, who rose to political prominence as a leader of campaigns by the Radical Party that legalized abortion and divorce in the 1970s in heavily Roman Catholic Italy, against the objections of the Vatican, has died.

headlines.title: ‘Never Forget’: How Americans remember Sept. 11
headlines.description: From an 11-year-old watching the towers fall on a classroom TV to a doctor treating victims in a conference room, NBC News readers share their searing memories from Sept. 11, 2001.

headlines.title: Inflation ticked up in August, setting the stage for the Fed to hike interest rates
headlines.description: Inflation overall in August rose by 0.4% month over month to an annual rate of 3.4%, which was unchanged from July.

headlines.title: Diesel hits all-time high of $6 per gallon and just about everything will cost more
headlines.description: “We are endangering one of the strongest economic pillars that we have in this country,” said fourth-generation Iowa farmer Mark Mueller.
